primary_context.fact: Official March 24 2026 patch fixes enhanced Ricochet Rounds stat benefit; exact Range/Stability values and bounce policies are not enumerated.

content_policies: Maximum surface bounces remains an explicit positive integral weapon parameter. Tests use one; no universal Destiny maximum is inferred.
Perk grant and intrinsic bounce capacity use MAX. Same-perk Range and Stability families use MAX; other families remain additive. Original duplicate-source stacking requires further calibration.
Range points feed existing endpoint curves before cumulative-path falloff. The test interpolation, damage/ammo/fire-rate bases and weakpoint geometry remain synthetic.

Ricochet alone does not grant penetration or shield damage. A second, independent synthetic socket combines Armor-Piercing Rounds for engine composition tests; this is not a legal D2 roll or full Seraph Rounds definition.
Reference consumer defaults to excluding origin and one contact per target; the core supports configurable origin/re-entry policy, which remains uncalibrated for original weapons.

Stability is an equipped numeric query; actual recoil/flinch/accuracy and aim presentation are not implemented by this change. Formal content catalogue, visual ricochets, loadout/HUD and physical world restart remain incomplete.
